row.title: LAUNCH-PATH-1: a visitor with no code agent launches from one form post
row.body: An idea typed at ultrastable.io gets a launch record (site/graduate.js). deploy/launch-apps.mjs, run daily by tenant-repos.yml, deploys the idea's own system through the site worker's OIDC route, creates its repository from ultrastable/seed, files the owner's plain-words requests there and invites the owner on request. Without an org credential the app stays live and managed and the repository waits (gate visitor-app-repos). A test idea walks the front door on every run. Still open: Q-LAUNCH-1, Q-LAUNCH-2.
